equipment.sheet.label: Equipment details
equipment.v2.levels.title: Exercises by level
equipment.autoCue.chest.1: Keep your shoulder blades pulled together throughout the movement
equipment.autoCue.chest.2: Lower with control and press up through the full range
equipment.autoCue.back.1: Start the pull from your shoulder blades, not your elbows
equipment.autoCue.back.2: Keep your core tight and don’t arch your lower back
equipment.autoCue.shoulders.1: Brace your core before every rep
equipment.autoCue.shoulders.2: Don’t push into a painful range. Stop where you feel in control
equipment.autoCue.biceps.1: Keep your elbows tight to your body, don’t flare them out
equipment.autoCue.biceps.2: Breathe out as you pull, breathe in as you lower
equipment.autoCue.triceps.1: Keep your elbows close to your body throughout the movement
equipment.autoCue.triceps.2: Use the full range, with a full lockout at the top of each rep
equipment.autoCue.abs.1: Breathe steadily, don’t hold your breath
equipment.autoCue.abs.2: Focus the squeeze in your abs, not your shoulders
equipment.autoCue.core.1: Breathe steadily, don’t hold your breath
equipment.autoCue.core.2: Focus the squeeze in your abs, not your shoulders
equipment.autoCue.obliques.1: The movement comes from your waist, not your arms
equipment.autoCue.obliques.2: Keep your pelvis stable and slow down for quality
equipment.autoCue.quads.1: Keep your knees in line with your toes, not caving in
equipment.autoCue.quads.2: Go down to at least 90° and keep your weight over the middle of your foot
equipment.autoCue.hamstrings.1: Lower slowly, 3 seconds on the way down
equipment.autoCue.hamstrings.2: Keep your back neutral and your pelvis locked
equipment.autoCue.glutes.1: Push through your heels, not your toes
equipment.autoCue.glutes.2: Lock your hips at the top and squeeze fully
equipment.autoCue.calves.1: Rise slowly and stretch fully at the bottom
equipment.autoCue.calves.2: Don’t bounce, keep every rep even
equipment.autoCue.fullBody.1: Start at a controlled pace until you can feel the technique
equipment.autoCue.fullBody.2: Breathe out on the effort, breathe in on the easy part
equipment.autoCue.legs.1: Keep your weight over the middle of your foot throughout the rep
equipment.autoCue.legs.2: Don’t let your knees cave in, push them out on purpose
equipment.autoCue.generic.1: Keep the movement controlled, no need to rush
equipment.autoCue.generic.2: Focus each rep on the target muscle, not momentum
